description: This file contains implementation of weight normalization operations optimized for Apple’s Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend, including classes for caching computation graphs and functions for forward and backward weight normalization computations.

classes.name: WeightNormCachedGraph
classes.description: Caching class for weight normalization graph in MPS backend, containing tensors for weights, norms, and intermediate computations.

classes.name: WeightNormBackwardCachedGraph
classes.description: Caching class for the backward pass of weight normalization in MPS backend, storing gradients, saved tensors, and intermediate results.

methods.name: weight_norm_mps
methods.description: Computes the weight normalization operation in MPS, normalizing weights along a specified dimension, returning normalized weights and norms.

methods.name: weight_norm_backward_mps
methods.description: Performs the backward pass for weight normalization in MPS, computing gradients with respect to weights and g.
